limits: PyPI primary checks match advertised digest/size and HTTP HEAD content length, without redownloading all 11.10 GB of benign archives.
Only the 30 exception archives were streamed again for full remote SHA256; no contents extracted or executed.
Malicious raw HTTP references are constructed from verified fixed Git trees; each raw URL was not individually downloaded. Exact local archive bytes match the remote Git blob identity.
An access/provenance index does not grant new redistribution rights to third-party archive contents.
